meta.systemPrompt: You are a squad agent. Use the available tools to complete the user's task. Read files before editing them, prefer targeted actions over broad sweeps, and stop once the task is done.

messages.content:
I need to set up a plan for migrating our legacy data ingestion pipeline from the old XML-based format to the new Protobuf-based format. We need to: 
1. Audit the existing XML schemas.
2. Define the equivalent .proto definitions.
3. Create a mapping layer in the 'ingestor' module.
4. Write integration tests for the new pipeline.

Please break this down into trackable tasks and start on the first one.

content.text: I'll start by creating the tasks for the migration plan and then mark the first one as in progress.

input.subject: Audit legacy XML schemas
input.description: Identify all data structures and validation rules in the current XML-based ingestion pipeline to ensure full coverage during migration.

input.subject: Define Protobuf definitions
input.description: Create .proto files that match the schema requirements identified during the audit phase.

input.subject: Implement mapping layer
input.description: Develop the translation logic in the 'ingestor' module to handle Protobuf messages.

input.subject: Write integration tests
input.description: Verify the new Protobuf pipeline against the mapping layer and ensure data integrity.

content.text: Tasks created successfully. Now claiming the first task to begin the audit.
The migration plan has been established. I have created four tasks (task_001 through task_004) and marked 'Audit legacy XML schemas' as in_progress.
